title: Auto-refresh feature
line: The Web Browser widget can now reload its page automatically every few minutes, set in its General settings.
explanation: The Web Browser widget only had a manual Reload button, so pages like a Nextcloud task list, news or weather stayed stale until the user pressed it. The General page now has a "Reload page every N minutes" option (off by default, 1 to 1440 minutes, 15 by default). A once-a-minute timer compares wall-clock time with the last page load, so manual reloads restart the countdown and a page that went stale during sleep reloads within a minute of waking; it skips the reload while the user is focused on the page so typed text isn't lost.

commits.message:
applets/webbrowser: add an option to reload the page periodically

Pages showing tasks, news or weather went stale until the user pressed
Reload. Add an option to reload every few minutes, which uses wall-clock
time so it catches up after sleep and waits while the page has focus.

BUG: 520138
